changelog:
Each recorder's last 24 hours now shows as hourly bars on its card in the Site Manager and the app.
The Site Manager has a Contact us form.
Digital zoom now works on the Site Manager live wall.
Hardware acceleration is on by default, with one switch in Settings > Hardware.
The app's switches match its theme, and cameras are turned on and off with a switch.
In the app, sliding your finger off a recorder's card no longer opens it.
